consequences: Rejected: default review none (loses human record), agent approval (breaks person-approves rule). Sending a task back may find work built on it.
context: Sati exists so agents can keep working; review gating dependents stalled 498 tasks on one person.
decision: A dependency in review, done or cancelled no longer blocks dependents (CLEARS_DEPENDENTS). Approval stays person-only. ADR 0010.
title: Work in review unblocks its dependents
